source_text: In September 2013, the Ombudspersons for Children from Denmark, Finland, Iceland, Norway, and Sweden released a joint statement declaring non-therapeutic circumcision of boys a violation of children's rights under the UN Convention on the Rights of the Child, emphasizing the procedure's infringement on bodily integrity and self-determination. [45]
